product.name: CloudPital EMR Software
product.description: A cloud-based electronic medical records system that manages patient data, appointments, clinical notes, and billing for healthcare providers.

product.name: CloudPital Hospital Information System (HIS)
product.description: A module for managing hospital operations including patient admissions, bed allocation, inpatient records, billing, and reporting.

product.name: CloudPital Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
product.description: A back-office management system covering accounting, finance, asset management, procurement, and reporting for healthcare organizations.

product.name: AI-Powered Care Plans
product.description: An AI-driven system that monitors patient vitals and generates personalized care plans to support clinical decision-making.

product.name: CloudPital Telehealth Platform
product.description: A telemedicine solution with AI-powered diagnostics, video consultations, voice-to-text transcription, and patient monitoring features.

product.name: AI-Powered Insurance Claims Processing
product.description: An AI-based system to automate insurance claims processing, reduce errors, detect fraud, and speed up reimbursements.
